hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: $1$ and itself.

The factors of $27$ are $1, 3, 9,$ and $27.$

$27$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $54$ are $1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18, 27,$ and $54.$

$54$ has $8$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $69$ are $1, 3, 23,$ and $69.$

$69$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $95$ are $1, 5, 19,$ and $95.$

$95$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $97$ are $1$ and $97.$

$97$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.
